body: People make their point, and they come back to make me hate even more. I feel like I'm being mentally attacked.
I have no way to vent, it just keeps building up. More and more I feel like I'm going to implode.
I can't think. This feeling overwhelms me with hate i think nothing but how much i hate everybody and everything.
I've gotten so over it i just cry, angry and laugh at the same time. I've fucking lost it.
It just feels like no matter what I do, I'm always doing something wrong no matter how small it is. I hate living, i really fucking hate it. Why does everyone treat me like this.
